alcaz-prison.hint: Island off the north-east coast; go in the keep, down to the basement

blackfathom-deeps.hint: Swim down an underwater shaft on the Zoram Strand coast

blackrock-depths.hint: Cross the chain to the central island, then down past Grinding Quarry

blackwing-lair.hint: Orb of Command at the end of the right-hand hall by the Spire entrance

city-of-dalaran.hint: Sewer grate on Dalaran's west wall; needs the Dalaran Sewer Key

dire-maul-east.hint: Warpwood Quarter is the east wing, in north-central Feralas

dire-maul-north.hint: Gordok Commons is the north wing, in north-central Feralas

dire-maul-west.hint: Capital Gardens is the west wing, in north-central Feralas

excavation-site-wetlands.hint: Stone and instance line are together at Whelgar's Excavation Site

gnomeregan.hint: Elevator down to the Train Depot; front door south, back door north

hall-of-thanes.hint: Below the High Seat; stairs down from a left turn by Deliana

kroldok-stronghold.hint: North of Sunnyglade, near the Badlands / Redridge way into the zone

lower-blackrock-spire.hint: South side of the Hall of Blackhand, opposite the Upper Spire

maraudon.hint: Tunnel to Zaetar's Choice; three wing portals, one in an alcove

molten-core.hint: Portal at the far bottom of Blackrock Depths

naxxramas.hint: Classic necropolis floated above the Eastern Plaguelands

onyxias-lair.hint: Cave mouth carved like a dragon's maw in the Wyrmbog

ragefire-chasm.hint: Portal is beside Neeru Fireblade's tent

razorfen-downs.hint: Far southern edge of the Barrens, east side, in brambles

razorfen-kraul.hint: Far southern edge of the Barrens, west side

ruins-of-ahnqiraj.hint: Through the Gates, take the left portal

ruins-of-lordaeron.hint: Ruins above Undercity, near the entrance used from Brill

scholomance.hint: Barov house ruins on a rise above Caer Darrow

shadowfang-keep.hint: Keep on a high bluff above Pyrewood Village

shapers-terrace.hint: Instance line is at the crater's northern pylon

stratholme-live.hint: Main gate of the city, north of the Plaguewood

stratholme-undead.hint: Back door; its own portal sits inside the Eastwall Gate (retail text)

temple-of-ahnqiraj.hint: Through the Gates, take the right portal

temple-of-atalhakkar.hint: Portal is in the Hall of Masks, past the flooded Broken Hall

the-deadmines.hint: Entered from the town of Moonbrook, south-west Westfall

the-drowned-city.hint: Underwater, south of Haunted Isle and due west of Grom'gol

the-stockade.hint: Building on the north canal by the Mage Quarter, stairs down

uldaman.hint: A side entrance lies between Fuselight and Tomb of the Watchers

upper-blackrock-spire.hint: Same portal as the Lower Spire; keep to the left wall

wailing-caverns.hint: North side of the Lushwater Oasis, south of the Crossroads

zulgurub.hint: North-east Stranglethorn; the raid is an outdoor zone
